title: Casper and the Verdict
author: R. M. Eriksen
blurb: Noor Kavanagh, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
